# Results (synthetic)

Accuracy did not differ (t(48) = 1.20), whereas sensitivity differed markedly between readers (P < .001).

Rates differed between arms (χ2(1) = 2.50; Fisher's exact P = .030).

The time effect was not significant, F(2, 96) = 3.20, P = .061 (Greenhouse–Geisser).

Rank scores differed (U = 12, z = 2.10, P = .061, exact test).

Scores differed, t(48) = 1.20; P < .001.
